headline: Fresh Flips Stir the Contested Lines
war_summary: Since the last edition, Marban Hollow logged five base-event rows in the latest two hours, Mooring County four, Weathered Expanse seven and Linn Mercy four. Such rows may record both loss and capture in one transition, but these fronts remain active. Marban now stands at two Warden, three Colonial and three unheld bases, against three, three and two in the previous report. Weathered has shifted from five Warden, one Colonial and three unheld to four, one and four. Linn Mercy now has ten Colonial-held bases, none Warden-held and one unheld, compared with eight, two and one. Nevish Line has two fresh event rows and now lists all eight bases as Warden-held; the previous report showed one unheld. Mooring County remains entirely Warden-held despite renewed activity. Stonecradle has had no event in the latest two hours, but two in six, and remains seven Colonial to two Warden. Kuura Strand’s event pace has eased, with none in two hours after two in six, while all six bases remain Colonial-held. War 140 is undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
